articles.headline: Brutal sell-off for AI stocks sends Wall Street reeling; S&P 500 tumbles 4.4%
articles.summary: A sharp sell-off hit Wall Street on Thursday, led by AI data center stocks, erasing previous gains. The S&P 500 fell 4.4% to 7,353.73, the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1,833.06 points to 51,523.06, and the Nasdaq composite tumbled 5.5% to 24,315.00. Investors grew concerned over high borrowing costs for data centers, bubble valuations, and Democratic victories in Tuesday's U. S. midterm elections raising risks of construction pauses due to power bill increases. Nvidia dropped 9.3%, Advanced Micro Devices fell 17.3%, CoreWeave fell 9.8%, and GE Vernova sank 7.5%. In contrast, AppLovin jumped 31% after strong earnings and a buyback program, and Tapestry rallied 7.1% on a better profit outlook. Brent crude oil rose 3.9% to $98.29, while the 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.84%.
articles.summary_zh: 周四华尔街遭遇严重抛售，由人工智能数据中心相关股票领跌，抹去了前一天的涨幅。 标普500指数下跌4.4%至7353.73点，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌1833.06点至51523.06点，纳斯达克综合指数大跌5.5%至24315.00点。 投资者对数据中心高昂的借贷成本、泡沫化估值以及周二美国中期选举中民主党获胜可能因电费上涨而暂停数据中心建设的风险感到担忧。 英伟达下跌9.3%，超威半导体下跌17.3%，CoreWeave下跌9.8%，GE Vernova下跌7.5%。 相比之下，AppLovin因财报靓丽及股票回购计划暴涨31%，Tapestry因利润预期上调上涨7.1%。 布伦特原油价格上涨3.9%至每桶98.29美元，10年期美国国债收益率跌至4.84%。

articles.headline: 3 Growth Stocks With Earnings Growth Up To 58%
articles.summary: October's US jobs report showed 165,000 new roles created, indicating a strong and stable labor market that supports financially sound companies with rapid earnings growth. This article highlights Marvell Technology and Oracle as two such candidates. Marvell Technology generates about US$9.5b in revenue, primarily through integrated circuits, with a market capitalization of US$117.3b. Its data-center connectivity hardware links to cloud spending, and management guided optical interconnect at 50%+ YoY growth in FY2027. Oracle generates about US$62.8b from cloud and software, US$5.8b from services, and US$3.2b from hardware, with a market capitalization of US$359.0b. Its cloud applications and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure anchor recurring revenue, and OpenAI expanded its cloud footprint to include Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in 2024.
articles.summary_zh: 10月份美国就业报告显示新增165000个工作岗位，表明劳动力市场强劲且稳定，能够支持财务稳健且盈利预期快速增长的公司。 本文重点介绍了美满电子科技和甲骨文这两家符合该特征的公司。 美满电子科技的营收约为95亿美元，主要通过集成电路业务产生，市值达1173亿美元；其数据中心连接硬件与云支出挂钩，管理层预计2027财年光互连业务同比增长将超过50%。 甲骨文通过云和软件业务产生约628亿美元营收，服务业务产生58亿美元，硬件业务产生32亿美元，市值达3590亿美元；其云应用程序和甲骨文云基础设施巩固了经常性软件和人工智能基础设施收入，OpenAI在2024年将其云业务范围扩展至包含甲骨文云基础设施。

articles.headline: Intel is the worst-performing S&P 500 stock in Q4, down 57%, what exactly happened?
articles.summary: Kalshi highlighted that Intel's shares declined 57% in Q4, making it the worst-performing S&P 500 stock and performing weaker than other big semiconductor companies. The sharp fall followed Intel's latest quarterly results, raising investor concerns. Media reports indicated that Intel's client computing business has faced pressure from weakened PC demand, while rising memory prices have made computers more expensive and further impacted demand. Additionally, investors have reportedly questioned whether Intel's investments in rebuilding its semiconductor manufacturing business and expanding manufacturing capacity will generate expected returns.
articles.summary_zh: 预测市场平台Kalshi指出，英特尔股价在第四季度下跌了57%，成为标普500指数中表现最差的股票，且表现弱于其他大型半导体公司。 股价的大幅下跌源于英特尔最新公布的季度业绩，引发了投资者的担忧。 据媒体报道，英特尔的客户端计算业务面临着个人电脑需求减弱的压力，同时内存价格上涨使得电脑价格更加昂贵，进而影响了需求。 此外，据报道投资者对英特尔为重建半导体制造业务及扩大制造产能所进行的投资能否产生预期回报存有疑虑。

articles.headline: 4,295 Tesla, Inc. $TSLA Shares Bought by Tamar Securities LLC
articles.summary: Tamar Securities LLC increased its Tesla stake by 7.1% in the third quarter, purchasing 4,295 shares to hold a total of 64,935 shares valued at $23,040,000, representing 2.1% of its holdings. Other major institutional investors also modified stakes in the second quarter, including Legal & General Group Plc ($8,535,612,000), Bank of New York Mellon Corp ($6,083,630,000), Deutsche Bank AG ($4,039,090,000), Canada Pension Plan Investment Board ($3,144,509,000), and Mitsubishi UFJ Asset Management Co. Ltd. ($2,995,584,000). Institutional investors own 66.20% of the stock. Wall Street analyst ratings include a consensus target price of $414.51 and a consensus rating of 'Moderate Buy'. Key news includes Elon Musk stating Tesla plans to wind down Cybertruck production at its Texas factory around mid-2027 to make room for Cybercab robotaxis, alongside an AI-accelerator roadmap. In insider transactions, CFO Vaibhav Taneja sold 2,606 shares on September 8th for $938,498.78. Tesla stock traded up $14.53 to $358.22 during midday trading with a volume of 36,597,110 shares.
articles.summary_zh: Tamar Securities LLC在第三季度将其特斯拉持股比例提高了7.1%，增购了4295股，持有该电动汽车制造商共64935股股票，价值23040000美元，占其持股的2.1%。 其他多家机构投资者和对冲基金也在第二季度调整了持股，其中包括Legal & General Group Plc（约8535612000美元）、纽约梅隆银行（约6083630000美元）、德意志银行（约4039090000美元）、加拿大养老金计划投资委员会（约3144509000美元）以及三菱日联资产管理有限公司（2995584000.66美元）。 机构投资者持有该股票66.20%的股份。 华尔街分析师给出的平均目标价为414.51美元，综合评级为“温和买入”。 重要新闻包括埃隆·马斯克表示特斯拉计划在2027年中期左右逐步停止其得克萨斯工厂的Cybertruck生产，以为Cybercab自动驾驶出租车腾出空间，同时公布了人工智能加速器路线图。 在内部交易方面，首席财务官Vaibhav Taneja于9月8日以938498.78美元的价格售出2606股特斯拉股票。 特斯拉股票在盘中交易中上涨14.53美元，达到358.22美元，成交量为36597110股。

articles.headline: Apple Completes the Set: Every Magnificent Seven Stock Opts Out of OKX-ICE Venue
articles.summary: Every member of Wall Street's 'Magnificent Seven' has opted out of OKX and ICE's planned tokenized stock venue. Apple, Meta Platforms, Home Depot, Boeing, GE Vernova, Palantir, ServiceNow, S&P Global, KLA, Super Micro Computer, and Nebius Group were added in an updated notice from OKXICE TSV on Thursday, bringing the total objecting companies to 67. They join Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Nvidia, and Tesla, all of which previously objected. Under SEC innovation rules, a venue must notify a company before offering third-party tokenized shares, and if the company objects in writing within 30 days, the venue cannot offer the stock. OKXICE TSV, a joint venture between Intercontinental Exchange and OKX's U. S. holding company, plans to offer tokenized U. S. stocks 24/7 on OKX's XLayer blockchain via an outside tokenizer holding real shares through a registered broker-dealer.
articles.summary_zh: 华尔街“七大科技巨头”的所有成员现在都选择不加入OKX与洲际交易所计划推出的代币化股票交易平台。 苹果、Meta平台、家得宝、波音、GE Vernova、帕兰提尔、ServiceNow、标普全球、科磊、超微电脑和Nebius集团在OKXICE TSV周四更新的通知中被加入，使反对该平台的公司总数达到67家。 此前反对的微软、Alphabet、亚马逊、英伟达和特斯拉也位列其中。 根据美国证券交易委员会的创新规则，交易平台在提供第三方代币化股票之前必须通知相关公司，如果该公司在30天内以书面形式提出异议，交易平台则不得提供该股票。 由洲际交易所美国控股公司与OKX美国控股公司各持股50%的合资企业OKXICE TSV计划通过注册经纪商持有真实股票，在OKX的XLayer区块链上的许可池中全天候提供美国代币化股票。

articles.headline: Nasdaq Slides 5.52% as Nvidia and AMD Drive a Broad Tech Rout
articles.summary: U. S. technology stocks suffered a broad rout, with the Nasdaq Composite falling 5.52% in its steepest one-day drop in 19 months. Nvidia fell 9.26% and AMD dropped more than 17%. Losses spread across AI infrastructure companies, memory, and optical networking stocks. Market-value losses were estimated at $2.9 trillion for S&P 500 constituents and $2.5 trillion for Nasdaq constituents, while the Magnificent Seven lost about $1.04 trillion combined. Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, Apple, Tesla, and SpaceX also recorded significant declines. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average recorded their steepest daily declines since April 2025.
articles.summary_zh: 美国科技股遭遇全面大跌，纳斯达克综合指数下跌5.52%，创下19个月来最大单日跌幅。 英伟达下跌9.26%，AMD跌幅超过17%。 损失蔓延至人工智能基础设施、存储和光通信网络股票。 标普500指数成分股的市值损失估计为$2.9 trillion，纳斯达克成分股损失$2.5 trillion，美股七巨头合计损失约$1.04 trillion。 亚马逊、字母表、微软、Meta、苹果、特斯拉和太空探索技术公司均录得显著下跌。 标普500指数和道琼斯工业平均指数也创下了自2025年4月宣布关税以来的最大单日跌幅。

articles.headline: Wall Street May Have Lost $2.5 Trillion, but This 30% Warning Could Be an Even Bigger Problem for AI Stocks
articles.summary: UBS estimated that about 30% of the data-center capacity the U. S. plans to add in 2028 could be at risk due to challenges in power, transmission, construction labor, cooling, financing, and local approvals. Nvidia reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 Data Center revenue of $89.023 billion, up 117% year over year, and guided third-quarter revenue to $108.0 billion plus or minus 2%. Nvidia’s supply obligations rose to $279.00 billion, while guarantee obligations to AI cloud and data-center partners are capped at $108.5 billion. CFO Colette Kress noted that supply remains a bottleneck, and Broadcom CEO Hock Tan highlighted land, power, and shell as major constraints.
articles.summary_zh: 瑞银估计，由于电力、输电、施工劳动力、冷却、融资和地方审批方面的挑战，美国计划在2028年增加的数据中心容量中约有30%可能面临风险。 英伟达公布2027财年第二季度数据中心收入为$89.023 billion，同比增长117%，并预计第三季度收入为$108.0 billion上下浮动2%。 英伟达的供应义务升至$279.00 billion，而对人工智能云和数据中心伙伴的担保义务上限为$108.5 billion。 首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯指出供应仍然是瓶颈，博通首席执行官陈福阳则强调土地、电力和外壳是主要制约因素。

articles.headline: Notable tech headlines for the week: AMD, Qualcomm and Lumentum in focus
articles.summary: Qualcomm shares plunged after smartphone chip revenue tumbled 26% in the fourth quarter, reporting an adjusted EPS of $2.17 and revenue of $10.44B for the period ending Sept. 27. Marvell Technology disclosed an all-stock deal to acquire Lumentum at an enterprise value of $115B, with CEOs of both companies securing Jensen Huang's blessing beforehand. AMD reported third-quarter results and guidance that topped forecasts, recording a charge of over $1B tied to performance-based stock warrants issued to OpenAI and Meta. Micron Technology suspended plans for a memory chip plant in Taiwan amid a labor dispute.
articles.summary_zh: 高通股价在第四季度智能手机芯片收入暴跌26%后大跌，其截至9月27日的第四季度调整后每股收益为$2.17，营收为$10.44B。 迈威科技披露了一项以全股票方式收购Lumentum的交易，企业估值为$115B，两家公司首席执行官在宣布前获得了黄仁勋的支持。 AMD公布了超出预测的第三季度业绩和指引，并计入了与向OpenAI和Meta发行的绩效股票认股权证相关的超过$1B的费用。 美光科技在劳资纠纷中暂停了在台湾地区建设存储芯片厂的计划。

articles.headline: 任天堂株式会社（東証：7974）の中間決算：アナリストが今年について予測している内容は以下の通り
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: Nintendo released its interim financial results, reporting net sales of 966 billion yen, which was 2.2% below expectations, while statutory earnings per share reached 63.75 yen, matching analyst forecasts. Following the results, 27 analysts projected fiscal 2027 net sales to reach 2.30 trillion yen, representing a 5.7% growth compared to the past 12 months, with statutory earnings per share predicted to be 375 yen. Analysts' consensus target price remained unchanged at 10,191 yen. Projections indicate Nintendo's annual sales growth rate through the end of 2027 will reach 12%, outpacing the broader industry's forecasted annual growth rate of 4.2%.
articles.summary_zh: 任天堂发布了中期财务业绩，报告净销售额为9660亿日元，比预期低2.2%，而法定每股收益达到63.75日元，与分析师预测基本一致。 财报公布后，27位分析师预测2027财年净销售额将达到2.30万亿日元，较过去12个月实现5.7%的增长，法定每股收益预计为375日元。 分析师的共识目标价维持在10191日元不变。 预测显示，到2027年底，任天堂的年销售额增长率将达到12%，超过更广泛行业预测的4.2%的年增长率。

articles.headline: 決算プラス・インパクト銘柄 【東証プライム】 … トヨタ、ソニーＧ、三菱商 (10月30日～11月5日発表分)(株探ニュース)
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 株探ニュースが10月30日から11月5日発表分の東証プライム銘柄を対象に、決算発表前日の終値を基準とした6日大引けまでの株価上昇率ランキングを発表しました。 ハリマ化成グループが上昇率29.95%で首位となり、上期経常変化率は167.67%でした。 続いてストライクが上昇率21.04%、HENNGEが上昇率19.77%を記録しました。 その他、AREホールディングス、コカ・コーラボトラーズジャパン、ヤマトホールディングスなどが上位にランクインし、トヨタ自動車やソニーグループ、三菱商事なども決算発表を受けて株価を押し上げています。
articles.summary_zh: 株探新闻公布了针对10月30日至11月5日发布财报的东证Prime板块股票，以财报发布前一日收盘价为基准至6日收盘时的股价上涨率排名。 ハリマ化成集团以29.95%的上涨率居首，其上半年经常利润变化率为167.67%。 紧随其后的是Stripe集团，上涨率21.04%，HENNGE上涨率19.77%。 此外，ARE控股、可口可乐日本饮料、大和控股等也进入前列，丰田汽车、索尼集团、三菱商事等也因财报发布而推高了股价。

articles.headline: 日経平均株価 一時4000円超下落
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 6日の日経平均株価は、前日比で一時4000円を超えて下落し、節目の6万円を割り込みました。 取引時間中に6万円を割るのは5月20日以来、およそ半年ぶりとなります。 前日の米国市場で主要三指数が揃って大幅安となったことが影響しました。 特に米国の中間選挙でデータセンター規制に前向きとされる民主党が大勝した結果が懸念され、アドバンテストやソフトバンクグループなどのAI・半導体関連株を中心にほぼ全面安の展開となりました。 市場関係者は、米中間選挙の結果を受けたAI投資の持続性に対する懸念から、行き過ぎた売りが広がっていると指摘しています。
articles.summary_zh: 6日的日经平均指数盘中一度较前一日下跌超过4000点，跌破6万点大关。 这是自5月20日以来约半年来首次在交易时间内跌破6万点。 该现象受到前一日美国市场主要三大指数全面大幅下跌的影响。 尤其是美国中期选举中倾向于支持数据中心监管的民主党大胜，引发市场担忧，以爱测试和软银集团等AI及半导体相关股票为中心，出现了几乎全线下跌的局面。 市场相关人士认为，受美国中期选举结果影响，对AI投资可持续性的担忧导致了过度的抛售。

articles.headline: USD exchange rate today (November 8): The US dollar experienced a week of mixed movements.
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: The USD Index (DXY) rose 0.39% this week to 102.28, driven by mixed factors including Middle East tensions, US midterm elections, AI investment concerns, and US economic data. The dollar fell early in the week amid plunging crude oil prices and declining US Treasury yields, but recovered later due to safe-haven demand and strong US jobs data showing 165,000 jobs added in October and an unemployment rate of 4.1%. On November 8, the State Bank of Vietnam announced the central exchange rate at 25,615 VND per USD, with buy-sell rates at 24,385 VND - 26,845 VND, while EUR and JPY exchange rates remained unchanged at the central bank.
articles.summary_zh: 衡量美元对六种主要货币汇率波动的美元指数（DXY）本周上涨0.39%至102.28，受到中东局势紧张、美国中期选举、人工智能投资担忧以及美国经济数据等多种因素交织影响。 由于原油价格暴跌和美国国债收益率下降，美元在周初下跌，但随后因避险需求增加以及10月新增165,000个就业岗位且失业率降至4.1%的强劲美国就业数据而复苏。 11月8日，越南国家银行公布越南盾兑美元的中央汇率报25,615 VND，国家银行交易所的买卖汇率维持在24,385 VND - 26,845 VND，同时欧元和日元在国家银行的汇率保持不变。

articles.headline: Will Bitcoin Go Back Up? 3 Scenarios Into Year-End 2026
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Bitcoin trades at about $75,700 on Saturday evening, November 7, 2026, which is 2.2% below October's close and 40% below the record of $126,080 set in October 2025. The price recovery depends on key levels, with November seeing a high of $81,105 on November 4 and a low of $74,762 on November 6. Market pressures stem from $1.28 billion in net outflows from spot bitcoin ETFs in the week to November 6, expectations of a Fed rate hike on December 9 with a 76.8% probability, extreme fear sentiment with a Fear and Greed Index of 25, and the ongoing impact of the Binance hack involving stolen crypto worth about $6.3 billion on October 29.
articles.summary_zh: 截至2026年11月7日星期六傍晚，比特币交易价格约为$75,700，比10月收盘价低2.2%，比2025年10月创下的$126,080的纪录低40%。 价格能否回升取决于关键点位，11月的高点为11月4日的$81,105，低点为11月6日的$74,762。 市场抛售压力源于截至11月6日的一周内现货比特币ETF净流出1.28 billion美元，12月9日美联储加息概率达到76.8%的预期，恐惧与贪婪指数为25的极端恐惧情绪，以及10月29日价值约6.3 billion美元的加密货币被盗的币安黑客事件的持续影响。

articles.headline: Fear and Greed Index at 28: What Extreme Fear Means
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Following a Friday sell-off, the Crypto Fear and Greed Index dropped to 28, sitting in the fear zone just above the 24 threshold for extreme fear. The index aggregates volatility, trading volume, social media activity, Bitcoin dominance, and Google search trends into a 0 to 100 score. Historical episodes show that extreme fear readings often precede strong rebounds over a six to twelve month horizon, though the market can remain depressed for weeks or months, as seen in 2022. Analysts note that a reading of 28 is ordinary sentiment rather than capitulation, and a true buy signal would require a drop into the low 20s combined with heavy leveraged liquidations similar to the wiping out of over a billion dollars in leveraged positions seen on Friday.
articles.summary_zh: 在周五的抛售之后，“加密货币恐慌与贪婪指数”跌至28，处于恐慌区间，略高于24的“极度恐慌”线。 该指数将波动性、交易量、社交媒体活动、比特币主导地位和谷歌搜索趋势综合为0到100的分数。 历史事件表明，极度恐慌的读数通常预示着在六到十二个月内会出现强劲反弹，但市场也可能像2022年那样持续数周或数月处于低迷状态。 分析人士指出，28的读数属于普通情绪而非投降式抛售，真正的买入信号需要指数跌入20低位，并伴随类似周五那样超过十亿美元杠杆头寸被清算的沉重抛压。

articles.headline: Daily Financial Breakfast 6 November 2026: BoE Lifts Rate to 4%; Fed's Williams Judges Inflation Too High
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Dow Jones futures stood near 51,170 after dropping 0.85% in early European trading on Friday, while S&P 500 futures rose 0.06% to around 7,390 and Nasdaq 100 futures gained 0.90% to about 26,990. EUR/USD retreated 0.4% to 1.1170, and AUD/USD traded near 0.6910. On Thursday, the Bank of England raised its Bank Rate by 25 basis points to 4.00%, backed by eight policymakers, with Catherine Mann voting for 50 basis points. The November Monetary Policy Report projected inflation at roughly 5% in the second quarter of 2027 and returning to the 2% target no earlier than the third quarter of 2028, with Governor Andrew Bailey warning that an adverse energy shock could push inflation to 6.2%. The Bank revised near-term growth to project GDP expansion of 1.6% in 2026, 1.3% in 2027, and 1.2% in 2028. Chief Economist Huw Pill stated that nothing is baked in for next year's interest rates. Meanwhile, New York Fed President John Williams emphasized that inflation has been too high for too long and must return to 2%, noting U. S. economic resilience, while initial U. S. jobless claims fell to 189,000. ECB Chief Economist Philip Lane highlighted energy inflation pressures on wages, and eurozone September producer prices rose 11.1% year-on-year, while the Bank of Mexico unexpectedly cut its policy rate by 25 basis points to 6.50%.

articles.headline: Dollar Gains on US Economic Strength and Hawkish Fed
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: The dollar index DXY rallied to a 1-week high and finished up by +0.71% following a stronger-than-expected US October payroll report and hawkish Federal Reserve comments. US October nonfarm payrolls rose +165,000, exceeding expectations of +70,000, while the unemployment rate unexpectedly dropped to 4.1% and average hourly earnings increased +0.4% month-over-month and +3.1% year-over-year. The University of Michigan US November consumer sentiment index rose to 51.0. New York Fed President Williams stated that inflation is absolutely too high, and San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly indicated expectations of further monetary policy tightening, leading markets to price in a 78% chance of a +25 bp rate hike at the December 8-9 FOMC meeting. In other markets, the 10-year Japanese government bond yield fell to a 4.5-month low of 2.612% on Friday, weighing on the yen and bringing the market pricing for a December 18 BOJ rate hike to 53%. December COMEX gold fell -0.94% and silver declined -0.83% due to pressure from the stronger dollar and rising stock recovery. Central bank data showed China's PBOC increased gold reserves by 740,000 ounces to 77.47 million troy ounces in September, marking twenty-three consecutive months of growth, whereas Russia reduced its gold reserves to 72.8 million ounces.
articles.summary_zh: 在好于预期的美国10月非农就业报告和美联储鹰派言论的推动下，美元指数DXY反弹至1周高点，收盘上涨+0.71%。 美国10月非农就业人口增加+165,000，超出+70,000的预期，失业率意外降至4.1%，平均时薪环比增长+0.4%，同比增长+3.1%。 密歇根大学美国11月消费者信心指数升至51.0。 纽约联储主席威廉姆斯表示通胀绝对过高，旧金山联储主席玛丽·戴利则表示预期将进一步收紧货币政策，导致市场定价显示12月8至9日FOMC会议加息+25个基点的概率为78%。 在其他市场中，周五日本10年期国债收益率跌至4.5个月低点2.612%，令日元承压，市场对日本央行12月18日加息的定价预期为53%。 受走强的美元和股市回升的压力影响，12月COMEX黄金收盘下跌-0.94%，白银下跌-0.83%。 央行数据显示，中国央行9月增持黄金740,000盎司，总量达到77.47百万金衡盎司，连续二十三个月增加黄金储备，而俄罗斯将其黄金储备减少至72.8百万盎司。
